 Convenience wrapper that enforces all invariants after every RK stage.

Detailed Description

Enforce the algebraic BSSN constraints \(\det\tilde{\gamma}=1\) and \(\mathrm{tr}\,\tilde{A}=0\).

RK stages drift away from the conformal manifold because compute_rhs_gamma_tilde and compute_rhs_A_tilde treat \(\tilde{\gamma}_{ij}\) and \(\tilde{A}_{ij}\) as unconstrained tensors. project_bssn_state rescales the metric and subtracts traces so the invariants monitored in BSSNInvariants.hpp remain within tolerance. Optional knobs let callers skip expensive steps when experimenting with alternative stabilization techniques.
